decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system still has unresolved upside and its carrying cost is modest, so the option value of waiting another year outweighs the cost of keeping it.
The coolant cleaning centrifuge remains an incremental option with no evidence that its value has resolved negatively, so the firm should hold the option rather than drop it.
As a scraper belt chip conveyor close to the established core, its value is likely more certain and negative resolution is not indicated, so the option remains worth holding at low cost.
Like D, the hinged belt chip conveyor is close to the existing product range and still listed, suggesting the option has not resolved to a point that justifies dropping it.
